subject: Class 375/7 and 375/8 Electrostar (45 units, one body), Southeastern navy, 2024-2026; face and lamps of the 375/8 (and /9). The 375/6 and 375/7 carry a third, separate tail lamp per side: note only.
method: Side elevation: the 375 diagram (Class466cuxton) is a pixel copy of the 377's, so door and window positions were taken from the 375709 side-on photo (two frames) by the same method run on the 377's own side-on photo; they agree with the 377 within 2%, so the 377 numbers stand where the photo agrees and the photo's numbers replace them where it does not (cab door droplight, cab side window). Face measured head-on on p803 (375803) with symmetric pairs (lamp centres, face silhouette) and body width 2.80 m; heights anchored on the orange line at 3.275 m and checked on the valance bottom and on p613. Livery from p607, p803, p814 (colours) and p802/p629/p805 (car 2 maroon).

calibration.notes: p803: face silhouette 1191..2614 px (half 711.5 px = 1.40 m) and lamp pairs centred at 1903.5/1903 -> 508 px/m; the 123x123 px headlamp lens shows the vertical scale equals the horizontal. Image rolled 0.0165 rad (orange line 660 px left vs 642.5 px right): y' = y + 0.0165 (x - 1903.5), centre line x = 1903.5 - 0.0165 (1540 - y). Heights y = 3.275 - (y' - 651.3)/508; check: valance bottom at 0.24 m (377 profile 0.28). Side: p709 (375709) side-on, f 2667 px (TZ40 25 mm equiv.), vertical scale per column from orange line to door bottom (2.335 m): 572.6 px/m at u 1300, 627 at u 3600; along-body distances from the reconstructed plane.

trace.sides: Positive m = right as seen head-on = the train's LEFT side looking forward from the cab. Side photos: p709 and p713 and p803 show the train's left side; p814, p802, p629 show its right side; dia/dia78 (nose left) its left side. Every side feature below is the same on both sides unless it says otherwise.

trace.face.gangwayFrame.bellows: Bellows (the gangway's sides between face and frame): grey rubber, darker and warmer than the pipeline's default #9A9EA2. Sampled on 379 g018 (crop f-gangway-018, the lit side of the folds, x 20-110 y 200-800: median #5E5A51) and balanced against the white bodyside in the same light (white-018 #A7A69F -> #F0F0F0): #87827A. The same Bombardier gangway on every gangwayed Electrostar; readers of this class's gangway crops see the same grey pleated bellows, so the 379 value is used.
trace.face.lampBack: The lamp bezel's back is the panel's yellow, behind a clear cover in a thin black rim with bolts (crop f-lamps / pair 'panel' on p803, 375803; the pairs reader: 'solid black housing, the photos show a yellow plate inside a thin black line'). The shared warning yellow, as the panel. Not so on the 379 and 387, whose bezels are black (their lamp crops).
trace.liveries.SE.shapes.doorTop: The band runs on over door 1's leaves, their tops maroon above the window top (p802, p629, p805; the elevation check 'car 2 door 1 top maroon'): drawn over the doors (layer 'doors').
